newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Bogawantalawa up on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Bogawantalawa up on growth prospects.

text.p: Bogawantalawa Plantations Ltd shares rose 5.5 percent or 1.75 rupees, to 33.50 on local buying on Friday, brokers said.
"Plantation shares are expected to see another good year in 1997, when Iraq fully enters the market," said a local broker.
Iraq, a major buyer of Sri Lanka tea before the Gulf War, is expected to buy tea from Colombo now that UN sanctions have been lifted, he said.
Last year was an exceptionally good year for plantations, with tea prices hitting record highs.
